through_line.name: la bulle d'air coincee dans le tube
through_line.progression: invisible en bloc un (on entend le bruit, on ne voit que la gene du personnage) -> localisee en bloc deux (les anneaux mint poussent les bulles le long du tube vide) -> ecrasee en bloc trois (la bulle eclate et ses ondes resonnent dans le tube vide, puis meurent quand la nourriture arrive) -> comprise en bloc quatre (le badge rejoue l'eclatement, le personnage comprend et se detend)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final rejoue l'eclatement de la bulle dans le badge au moment ou le personnage comprend : le bruit du hook ne venait pas de la faim mais d'une bulle ecrasee dans un tube que rien ne remplit

blocks.vo_line: Ton ventre gargouille en pleine réunion, et tout le monde croit que tu as faim. En réalité, ce bruit n'a presque rien à voir avec la faim.
blocks.through_line_state: invisible : on entend le gargouillis et on ne voit que la gene du personnage, le badge n'arrive qu'au dernier plan
shots: WIDE static: the person sits at the sandy table in the quiet meeting room, hands folded on the table, listening politely
MEDIUM static: three small baby blue bubble shapes pop into the air beside the person and wobble, one after another, like floating sound symbols
MEDIUM static: the person freezes wide-eyed, cheeks going soft pink, and folds both arms tightly across the front of the sandy sweater
CLOSE-UP low angle static: framed on the head and shoulders, they glance sideways off-frame with an awkward tight-lipped smile, shoulders creeping up
MEDIUM static: the bubble badge swings in from the right and settles beside the person with a bounce, two sparkles popping

blocks.vo_line: Tes intestins se serrent en vagues pour pousser leur contenu, même à vide. Ce brassage remue surtout de l'air et un peu de liquide.
blocks.through_line_state: localisee : les anneaux mint se resserrent en vague et poussent les bulles bleues le long du tube vide
shots: WIDE static: the pink tube at rest, the mint bands relaxed and evenly spaced, three baby blue bubbles drifting slowly inside
MEDIUM lateral gentle drift right: the first mint band tightens and squeezes the tube narrow, then relaxes as the next band tightens behind it, a wave travelling along
CLOSE-UP high angle static: the travelling squeeze pushes the bubbles forward down the tube, each bubble stretching as it is nudged along
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: one bubble caught under a tightening mint band, flattening and wobbling under the pressure
MEDIUM low angle static: pulled back on the whole tube, the wave of squeezes runs its full length while the bubbles tumble ahead of it

blocks.vo_line: Ce bruit vient des bulles qui passent dans un tube étroit, pas de ton estomac. Il est là après un repas aussi, masqué par la nourriture.
blocks.through_line_state: ecrasee : la bulle eclate et ses ondes traversent tout le tube vide ; des que les blocs sable remplissent le tube, le meme eclatement ne fait plus aucun bruit
shots: EXTREME CLOSE-UP static: one baby blue bubble is crushed thin between the tube wall and a tightening mint band, and bursts into three tiny bubbles, sending soft concentric ripple rings outward through the empty tube
WIDE static: the ripple rings race down the whole empty tube and bounce back off the far bend, crossing each other
MEDIUM static: rounded sandy yellow lumps drift in from the left and fill the tube, packing in snugly around the remaining bubbles
CLOSE-UP high angle static: a mint band squeezes again, a bubble is crushed exactly as before, but the ripple rings die instantly against the packed sandy lumps
MEDIUM low angle static: the full tube keeps squeezing in silence, the sandy lumps absorbing every ripple

blocks.vo_line: À jeun, plus rien ne vient amortir ce vacarme, et il résonne dans tout ton abdomen : abonne-toi, demain on regarde tes doigts fripés dans le bain.
blocks.through_line_state: comprise : le badge rejoue l'eclatement dans un tube vide au moment exact ou le personnage comprend, et la gene du hook se transforme en amusement
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the person still at the table, hands on their stomach, eyebrows lifting as a soft rumble passes through them
EXTREME CLOSE-UP static on the badge: inside the little tube the lone bubble pops and wide ripple rings spread out unchecked through the empty space
MEDIUM high angle static: the person's face clears as they understand, and they give a small amused headshake
MEDIUM static: they pat their own stomach twice with an open palm and grin openly at the camera, relaxed now
CLOSE-UP low angle static: the person points at the viewer, a rounded sandy yellow bell shape pops in beside them and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
